toefl:se:102.answer: When employees are trusted to make choices about their own work, as Andrew mentions, they feel a sense of ownership.
toefl:se:102.fullSentence: When employees are trusted to make choices about their own work, as Andrew mentions, they feel a sense of ownership.
toefl:se:102.japanese: アンドリューが述べるように、従業員が自分の仕事について選択することを任されると、当事者意識を感じます。
toefl:se:102.explanation: be trusted to doで「〜することを任される」を表す。
toefl:se:102.relatedInfo: feel invested in their work / take ownership of their tasks
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:103.answer: This usually motivates them to go beyond minimum expectations, instead of just doing what a manager tells them.
toefl:se:103.fullSentence: This usually motivates them to go beyond minimum expectations, instead of just doing what a manager tells them.
keyPhrases: instead of just doing what a manager tells them
toefl:se:103.japanese: これは通常、従業員が上司に言われたことをただこなすのではなく、最低限の期待を超えて取り組む動機になります。
toefl:se:103.explanation: motivate 人 to doで「人が〜する意欲を起こさせる」を表す。
toefl:se:103.relatedInfo: exceed expectations / go the extra mile
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:104.answer: Moreover, team-oriented management makes better use of employees' diverse skills.
toefl:se:104.fullSentence: Moreover, team-oriented management makes better use of employees' diverse skills.
toefl:se:104.japanese: さらに、チーム重視の経営は従業員の多様なスキルをより有効に活用します。
toefl:se:104.explanation: make better use ofで「〜をより有効に活用する」を表す。
toefl:se:104.relatedInfo: leverage diverse talents / tap into varied skill sets
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:105.answer: For instance, in a software company, programmers, designers, and marketers each understand different aspects of a product.
toefl:se:105.fullSentence: For instance, in a software company, programmers, designers, and marketers each understand different aspects of a product.
toefl:se:105.japanese: 例えばソフトウェア会社では、プログラマー、デザイナー、マーケターがそれぞれ製品の異なる側面を理解しています。
toefl:se:105.explanation: eachは複数の主語それぞれについて個別に述べる副詞的用法。
toefl:se:105.relatedInfo: bring different expertise / each specialize in different areas
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:106.answer: If every decision must go through a single manager, valuable ideas may be delayed or ignored.
toefl:se:106.fullSentence: If every decision must go through a single manager, valuable ideas may be delayed or ignored.
toefl:se:106.japanese: すべての意思決定が一人の管理者を通さなければならないとしたら、貴重なアイデアが遅れたり無視されたりする可能性があります。
toefl:se:106.explanation: go throughで「〜を経由する、通る」を表す。
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:107.answer: Allowing the team to decide together not only speeds up problem-solving but also leads to more creative solutions.
toefl:se:107.fullSentence: Allowing the team to decide together not only speeds up problem-solving but also leads to more creative solutions.
keyPhrases: allowing the team to decide together
toefl:se:107.japanese: チームで一緒に決定できるようにすることは、問題解決を早めるだけでなく、より創造的な解決策にもつながります。
toefl:se:107.explanation: not only A but also Bで「AだけでなくBも」を表す。
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:108.answer: I do agree with Claire that clarity is important, but a team-oriented approach does not have to be chaotic.
toefl:se:108.fullSentence: I do agree with Claire that clarity is important, but a team-oriented approach does not have to be chaotic.
keyPhrases: agree with claire that clarity is important
does not have to be chaotic
toefl:se:108.japanese: 明確さが重要だというクレアの意見には確かに賛成ですが、チーム重視のアプローチは必ずしも混沌としたものである必要はありません。
toefl:se:108.explanation: do agreeのdoは動詞を強調する用法。
toefl:se:108.relatedInfo: need not be disorganized / doesn't have to mean chaos
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:109.answer: A manager can still set clear goals and basic guidelines while letting employees decide how to reach those goals.
toefl:se:109.fullSentence: A manager can still set clear goals and basic guidelines while letting employees decide how to reach those goals.
keyPhrases: set clear goals and basic guidelines
toefl:se:109.japanese: 管理者は明確な目標と基本的なガイドラインを設定しつつ、その目標へどう到達するかは従業員に決めさせることができます。
toefl:se:109.explanation: whileは「〜する一方で」と同時進行の対比を表す。
toefl:se:109.relatedInfo: establish clear expectations / give employees autonomy
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:110.answer: In this way, companies get both structure and flexibility, which is why I consider the team-oriented style more effective overall.
toefl:se:110.fullSentence: In this way, companies get both structure and flexibility, which is why I consider the team-oriented style more effective overall.
toefl:se:110.japanese: このようにして、企業は構造と柔軟性の両方を得られます。これが、私がチーム重視のスタイルを全体としてより効果的だと考える理由です。
toefl:se:110.explanation: which is whyは「それが〜な理由だ」と結論をつなぐ表現。
toefl:se:110.relatedInfo: balance structure with flexibility / combine order and freedom
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性1

toefl:se:111.answer: In my opinion, for a company's success, the top-down approach is more effective for the following reasons.
toefl:se:111.fullSentence: In my opinion, for a company's success, the top-down approach is more effective for the following reasons.
toefl:se:111.japanese: 私の意見では、会社の成功のためには、以下の理由からトップダウン方式の方がより効果的です。
toefl:se:111.explanation: for the following reasonsは後に理由が続くことを予告する。
toefl:se:111.relatedInfo: a top-down management style / a hierarchical approach
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性2

toefl:se:112.answer: First, a supervisor can help the company grow faster by providing clear direction and making sure everyone is working toward the same goals.
toefl:se:112.fullSentence: First, a supervisor can help the company grow faster by providing clear direction and making sure everyone is working toward the same goals.
toefl:se:112.japanese: まず、上司は明確な方向性を示し、全員が同じ目標に向かって働くようにすることで、会社がより早く成長する手助けができます。
toefl:se:112.explanation: make sure〜で「〜であることを確実にする」を表す。
toefl:se:112.relatedInfo: provide clear guidance / align everyone's goals
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性2

toefl:se:113.answer: Some people think only employees can solve problems, but in reality, many companies have failed without a supervisor's guidance.
toefl:se:113.fullSentence: Some people think only employees can solve problems, but in reality, many companies have failed without a supervisor's guidance.
toefl:se:113.japanese: 従業員だけが問題を解決できると考える人もいますが、実際には多くの企業が上司の指導なしに失敗してきました。
toefl:se:113.explanation: in realityは「実際には」と前言を修正・対比する副詞句。
toefl:se:113.relatedInfo: lack proper leadership / fail due to a lack of direction
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性2

toefl:se:114.answer: With top-down management, responsibilities are clear, and the company avoids confusion that could slow down progress.
toefl:se:114.fullSentence: With top-down management, responsibilities are clear, and the company avoids confusion that could slow down progress.
toefl:se:114.japanese: トップダウン式の経営では、責任が明確であり、会社は進捗を遅らせかねない混乱を避けられます。
toefl:se:114.explanation: that以下はconfusionを修飾する関係代名詞節。
src: スーパーバイザーの必要性2

toefl:se:115.answer: I believe that discussing problems together is the best way to strengthen a friendship.
toefl:se:115.fullSentence: I believe that discussing problems together is the best way to strengthen a friendship.
keyPhrases: the best way to strengthen a friendship
toefl:se:115.japanese: 問題を一緒に話し合うことが友情を深める最良の方法だと私は考えます。
toefl:se:115.explanation: 動名詞句discussing problems togetherが主語。
toefl:se:115.relatedInfo: deepen a friendship / build a closer bond
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:116.answer: Like Claire, I agree that sharing experiences helps people connect at first, but I think real closeness develops when friends are willing to be vulnerable with each other.
toefl:se:116.fullSentence: Like Claire, I agree that sharing experiences helps people connect at first, but I think real closeness develops when friends are willing to be vulnerable with each other.
toefl:se:116.japanese: クレアと同様に、経験を共有することは最初に人々をつなげる助けになると思いますが、本当の親密さは友人同士が互いに弱さをさらけ出そうとするときに生まれると思います。
toefl:se:116.explanation: be willing to doで「進んで〜する」という意志を表す。
toefl:se:116.relatedInfo: open up to each other / let their guard down
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:117.answer: When friends talk honestly about their struggles—such as family conflict, stress about grades, or anxiety about the future—they show trust.
toefl:se:117.fullSentence: When friends talk honestly about their struggles—such as family conflict, stress about grades, or anxiety about the future—they show trust.
toefl:se:117.japanese: 家族の対立や成績へのストレス、将来への不安といった悩みについて友人が正直に話すとき、それは信頼を示すことになります。
toefl:se:117.explanation: ダッシュで具体例を挿入している。
toefl:se:117.relatedInfo: open up honestly / share their struggles
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:118.answer: This trust deepens the relationship far more than simply going to a concert or playing on the same sports team.
toefl:se:118.fullSentence: This trust deepens the relationship far more than simply going to a concert or playing on the same sports team.
toefl:se:118.japanese: この信頼は、単にコンサートに行ったり同じスポーツチームでプレーしたりするよりも、はるかに関係を深めます。
toefl:se:118.explanation: far more thanで比較を強調している。
toefl:se:118.relatedInfo: strengthen the bond far beyond / go much deeper than
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:119.answer: For example, I became much closer to a classmate after we talked about how overwhelmed we were during exam season.
toefl:se:119.fullSentence: For example, I became much closer to a classmate after we talked about how overwhelmed we were during exam season.
toefl:se:119.japanese: 例えば、私は試験期間中にどれほど圧倒されていたかについて話した後、あるクラスメートとずっと親しくなりました。
toefl:se:119.explanation: how overwhelmed we wereは間接疑問文でtalked aboutの目的語。
toefl:se:119.relatedInfo: grow much closer / bond over shared stress
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:120.answer: That conversation transformed us from casual friends into people who truly relied on each other.
toefl:se:120.fullSentence: That conversation transformed us from casual friends into people who truly relied on each other.
toefl:se:120.japanese: その会話は、私たちを単なる友人からお互いに本当に頼り合う関係へと変えました。
toefl:se:120.explanation: transform A from B into Cで「AをBからCへ変える」を表す。
toefl:se:120.relatedInfo: turn acquaintances into close friends / deepen a casual friendship
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:121.answer: In addition, as Paul notes, discussing problems helps us realize that we are not alone.
toefl:se:121.fullSentence: In addition, as Paul notes, discussing problems helps us realize that we are not alone.
keyPhrases: realize that we are not alone
toefl:se:121.japanese: さらに、ポールが指摘するように、問題を話し合うことは自分が一人ではないと気づく助けになります。
toefl:se:121.explanation: help us realize thatで「〜だと気づく助けになる」を表す。
toefl:se:121.relatedInfo: feel less isolated / know we're not the only one
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:122.answer: Knowing that someone understands our fears and still accepts us creates a powerful emotional bond.
toefl:se:122.fullSentence: Knowing that someone understands our fears and still accepts us creates a powerful emotional bond.
toefl:se:122.japanese: 誰かが自分の恐れを理解し、それでも受け入れてくれると知ることは、強力な感情的な絆を生み出します。
toefl:se:122.explanation: 動名詞Knowing that〜が主語になっている。
toefl:se:122.relatedInfo: forge a deep emotional connection / build an unbreakable bond
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:123.answer: Shared experiences create memories, but openly discussing shared challenges creates loyalty and long-term support.
toefl:se:123.fullSentence: Shared experiences create memories, but openly discussing shared challenges creates loyalty and long-term support.
toefl:se:123.japanese: 共有された経験は思い出を作りますが、共通の課題を率直に話し合うことは忠誠心と長期的な支えを生み出します。
toefl:se:123.explanation: but で2つの動名詞主語文を対比している。
toefl:se:123.relatedInfo: foster lasting loyalty / build long-term trust
src: 友情の深め方1

toefl:se:124.answer: In my opinion, discussing problems together is the best way to strengthen a friendship.
toefl:se:124.fullSentence: In my opinion, discussing problems together is the best way to strengthen a friendship.
keyPhrases: the best way to strengthen a friendship
toefl:se:124.japanese: 私の意見では、問題を一緒に話し合うことが友情を深める最良の方法です。
toefl:se:124.explanation: the best way to doで「〜する最良の方法」を表す。
toefl:se:124.relatedInfo: the most effective way to bond / strengthen ties
src: 友情の深め方2

toefl:se:125.answer: When we talk about our problems, we get to understand our friends on a deeper level and see their true thoughts and feelings.
toefl:se:125.fullSentence: When we talk about our problems, we get to understand our friends on a deeper level and see their true thoughts and feelings.
keyPhrases: understand our friends on a deeper level
toefl:se:125.japanese: 自分たちの問題について話すとき、私たちは友人をより深いレベルで理解し、その本当の考えや気持ちを知ることができます。
toefl:se:125.explanation: get to doで「〜する機会を得る」というニュアンス。
toefl:se:125.relatedInfo: know someone more deeply / see their genuine side
src: 友情の深め方2

toefl:se:126.answer: This kind of honesty can create trust and make our bond stronger.
toefl:se:126.fullSentence: This kind of honesty can create trust and make our bond stronger.
toefl:se:126.japanese: この種の正直さは信頼を生み出し、絆をより強くすることができます。
toefl:se:126.explanation: make A Bで「AをBにする」という使役的表現。
toefl:se:126.relatedInfo: foster mutual trust / reinforce the bond
src: 友情の深め方2
